scoring_justification: All artifacts are final computed quantities from DFT/DFPT; recomputing them from raw ABINIT outputs is infeasible without re-running the full calculation, so the checker compares reported values to paper gold with tolerances.

schema.description: A single float on the first line representing the indirect band gap in eV.

outputs.description: Indirect band gap of undoped BaHfN2.

schema.description: A single string on the first line representing the dominant orbital character at the conduction band minimum (e.g., 'Hf 5d_xy').

outputs.description: Orbital character of the conduction band minimum.

schema.description: Atom symbol (string), Zxx (float), Zyy (float), Zzz (float). In tetragonal symmetry Zxx equals Zyy.

outputs.description: Born effective charge tensors for Ba, Hf, N1, N2.

schema.description: Four floats on separate lines in order: epsilon_inf_xx, epsilon_inf_zz, epsilon_0_xx, epsilon_0_zz. Each is dimensionless.

outputs.description: High-frequency and static dielectric tensor components.

schema.description: Zone-center phonon frequencies for undoped BaHfN2. Columns: mode_label (string, e.g., '1-2'), symmetry (string), frequency_TO (float, cm⁻¹), frequency_LO (float, cm⁻¹; empty for Raman modes).

outputs.description: Zone-center optical phonon frequencies and LO-TO splittings for undoped BaHfN2.

schema.description: Zone-center phonon frequencies for doped Ba0.5La0.5HfN2. Columns: mode_label (string), frequency (float, cm⁻¹).

outputs.description: Zone-center phonon frequencies for the metallic La-doped system.

output_contract.notes: All scored artifacts are recomputed quantities from DFT/DFPT. The checker will compare them against paper-reported reference values with appropriate tolerances (not provided here). The structural relaxation steps are required prerequisites but are not directly scored; their execution is enforced by the load-bearing phonon steps.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for band gap, CBM character, Born effective charges, dielectric constants, undoped and doped phonon frequencies.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Tables I (E_g^exp LDA HGH semcore), II (BEC), IV (dielectric constants fully relaxed), III (phonon frequencies for undoped and doped).
hidden_assets.generation_method: All gold numbers are copied from the paper's tables. No fabrication.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's reported quantities and provide the hidden reference for result compare.
